title: Product of couplings
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets, and let $\kappa_A$ and $\kappa_B$ be probability mass functions on $A\times A$ and $B\times B$, respectively. Take the product law of these two couplings and rearrange each resulting pair $((a_1,b_1),(a_2,b_2))$ as the coupling $((a_1,b_1),(a_2,b_2))$ on $(A\times B)\times(A\times B)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\kappa_A$ is a probability mass function on $A\times A$
$\kappa_B$ is a probability mass function on $B\times B$
